name: Mastra
description: TypeScript agent framework whose starter CLI creates a runnable project with agents, workflows and a local Studio UI.
whatItDoes: Developers scaffold an application with autonomous agents that choose tools and iterate towards a goal, then test and manage them in Mastra Studio. It plugs into React, Next.js and Node or runs as a standalone server.
howItWorks: The create command generates a project for a chosen model provider. A model router gives access to many providers through one interface, and the dev server serves Studio at localhost:4111. Directories named `ee/` carry a separate enterprise licence; the rest is Apache-2.0.

requirements.name: Node.js
requirements.description: Runs the CLI and the project

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: For the provider chosen at project creation (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI)
